# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c38 P0](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Shirley  <sub>[v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056)</sub>; Anne of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c35 P0](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a tall, slender, and graceful girl with red hair and gray eyes. She has a white brow, a very neat nose, and shining eyes when excited. Her face is vivid and expressive, though she is self-conscious about her red hair and facial redness when she cries.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008), [v1 c34 P16](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0016), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c4 P65](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0065)_

## Personality

Anne is imaginative, ambitious, and deeply passionate about beauty, nature, and romance. She possesses a vibrant, thoughtful, and poetic mind, often viewing life through romantic ideals and poetic fancies. Highly conscientious and warm-hearted, she forms loyal, deep attachments with her friends and has a notable genius for friendship. Though prone to romantic disillusionment and sensitive about her past, she holds high standards for herself and loves a good sense of humor.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P8](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0008), [v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c34 P27](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0027), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v3 c4 P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c38 P4](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0004), [v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012)_

## History

Anne grew up at Green Gables in Avonlea and pursued her studies with great determination under Miss Stacy. She entered Queen's Academy alongside her Avonlea peers to take the intensive Second Year course, aiming for a First Class teacher's license within a single year. While living in a town boarding house, she experienced acute homesickness, which was eased by weekly Friday trips back to Avonlea. Throughout her studies at Queen's, she maintained a strong academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe, eventually setting her sights on the coveted Avery scholarship in English to attend Redmond College. Later, while attending Redmond College in Kingsport, she lived at Patty's Place with friends Stella, Priscilla, Aunt Jamesina, and Philippa Gordon. During her college years, she was courted by Roy Gardner, though she found herself reflecting on the deeper compatibility and shared humor she had with Gilbert Blythe. Upon completing her time at Redmond, she prepared to return to Avonlea while considering an offer to become principal of the Summerside High School.
